attrs.evidence: bridge/film_check.mjs 32/32. THE ERA WITNESSES, built by construction: E-1 (* x) emits one APP-ERA frame at t: reaching *; E-2 !{a,b} = *; lambda z.a emits one DUP-ERA frame at d:0 reaching lambda a.*, with only the LEFT projection live so find_projections takes its one-sided path; E-3 !{a,b} = *; (a b) has both projections live, so the sibling resolves through the substitution ic32 writes into heap[D]. All three replay on FloatRt and DescFloatRt with provenance observed. Two ERA forgeries: E-4 APP-ERA relabelled APP-LAM (sem-rule-mismatch -- unforgeable before this round because APP-ERA had never been emitted) and E-5 the dup-over-eraser named at d:7 on a fixture with exactly one live cell (sem-locus-not-enabled). W-1 measures the one-interaction guard's precondition across all six admitted dup head classes: DUP-LAM, DUP-SUP=, DUP-SUP!, DUP-ERA, DUP-VAR, DUP-APP, each at interaction delta 0 with canonical state unchanged, via ic32_film --probe-whnf, which asks the ONE classifier what it admits rather than re-deriving the classes. I-1 computes locus injectivity on the kernel's node graph across every state of church_exp_2_2 -- 44 distinct enabled redexes over 21 states, 0 carrying more than one canonical locus -- and reports the zero rather than staying silent, because a diagnostic that only speaks when it fires is indistinguishable from one that was never wired in. scope-is-stated-by-refusal derives the unwitnessed-rule set from the UNION of the fixtures' own films and checks the typed budget refusal on a 21-frame film under --budget 3. bridge/measure_compare.mjs, non-gating, 35/35 fixtures agree: the 24-vector corpus, three film fixtures, the three ERA fixtures and five single-dup-head fixtures, with 0 aliased loci on the JS side. THE FAMILY ID LOST ITS RELEASE VERSION: impl-c-ic32-film-v0.1.0 had sat beside a v0.3.0 binary for three releases, and family identity is stable across ordinary artifact releases while exact bytes are executable_artifact_id. Frozen probes keep the era string; only the live catalog moved.
attrs.revision_note: SUPERSEDED by @4 at round 27 pass B5, kept as history and not withdrawn: everything it claims is true and it is the record of the round in which the RULE POOL closed. What it could not say is that the emitter had exactly one terminal class -- a budget reached while work remained produced a typed refusal, so the only executions C could evidence were the ones that ran to quiescence.
attrs.statement: THE EXECUTION PLANE ORIGINATES EVIDENCE FOR THE INTERACTION-NET DYNAMICS THEMSELVES, rather than the governance plane reconstructing it around the execution plane afterwards. For a frozen fixture, the native C runtime independently emits a chained semantic film whose per-frame pre-state, enabled rule, PLANE, canonical locus and post-state, and whose terminal, are accepted by the existing TRVM-SEMFILM-v1.1 contract WITHOUT normalization or translation of meaning -- the law kernel's own replaySemFilm, imported unmodified, replaying on a fresh runtime of two different allocator classes. @1 SCOPED THIS TO THE APP PLANE and that was the whole frontier: application of a lambda at a tree locus is the part of the calculus a term-rewriting relation already models. @2 IS THE FLOAT PLANE. Enumeration covers the root tree AND EVERY LIVE DUP CELL; loci are canonical in three families -- t: a structural path, d: a DISCOVERY INDEX over live cells, v: a discovery index AND a path into a cell's value -- and AT @3 EVERY RULE OF THE DECLARED POOL HAS A POSITIVE NATIVE WITNESS: APP-LAM, APP-SUP, APP-ERA, DUP-LAM, DUP-SUP=, DUP-SUP!, DUP-ERA, DUP-VAR and DUP-APP. THE TWO ORDERS ARE DIFFERENT ORDERS AND BOTH ARE LOAD-BEARING: the kernel enumerates live cells right-to-left (liveHeap pushes children forward) and INDEXES loci left-to-right (liveDiscoveryOrder pushes them reversed), so one order decides which redex is leftmost and the other decides what number its locus carries; collapsing either onto the other produces a locus that names a real redex which is not the redex that fired. SCOPE, CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED AND STATED AS REFUSALS: an enumerated rule the emitter cannot fire is REFUSED BY NAME (film-rule-not-implemented) rather than silently skipped, and the pool is enumerated in full regardless of what is implemented -- so that 'no enabled work' cannot mean 'no work of the kinds I implement', which is how a false normal form is written down. THE SCOPE PREDICATE HAS MOVED FOUR TIMES AND EVERY MOVE WAS A CORRECTION (dup PRESENCE, dup ENABLEDNESS, the two ERA rules, and now nothing rule-shaped at all), so the law and its checks name the DURABLE property rather than the current gap. THE ERA RULES CLOSED BY CONSTRUCTION, NOT BY DISCOVERY: two purpose-built minimal fixtures -- (* x) is one APP-ERA frame, and !{a,b} = *; lambda z.a is one DUP-ERA frame with a SINGLE live projection, which also exercises the one-sided path through find_projections -- rather than one contrived term that happens to contain both. The conformance corpus contains NO ERA at all, which is why all 24 vectors could agree while two of nine rules had never run natively, and why these had to be BUILT rather than found. AND CANONICAL LOCUS ASSIGNMENT IS INJECTIVE OVER SEMANTIC REDEX IDENTITY: one redex gets at most one canonical locus. The representation makes an alias EXPRESSIBLE -- each findAppRedexes call carries its own visited set, so a node reachable both from the root and from inside a dup value is enumerable under a t: AND a v: locus -- and since the locus is committed into frame_id, two spellings of one transition would be two canonical frame identities for the same pre, rule and post. Identity is PHYSICAL and per-runtime and is therefore NOT a cross-implementation field: each side checks its own. Nothing in the measured fixtures produces an alias; the emitter REFUSES film-locus-alias rather than blessing both spellings, because precedence between them is UNRULED and choosing one silently would decide a rule nobody wrote down. THE ONE-INTERACTION GUARD IS POST-HOC BY RULING AND STAYS SO: it measures what the shipped runtime DID, including any future change inside fire() or whnf(), where a structural pre-check could only measure what is predicted. Its soundness depends on the emitter being FAIL-STOP -- a refusal exits, so a heap mutated before the guard fired never becomes accepted evidence, and a persistent service would need transactional scratch state. The PREDICTION behind it is measured separately rather than left as prose: whnf is INERT on every head class the one classifier admits, at interaction delta 0 AND canonical semantic state unchanged -- the second clause being the one a counter alone would miss, since whnf memoizes a stuck application's reduced head without counting an interaction. No second inline classifier was added to do this; two semantic recognizers can drift. A step budget reached while work remains is a TYPED REFUSAL (film-budget-exhausted) and never a terminal. The terminal is concluded only after a FRESH FULL-POOL ENUMERATION returns empty. AND THE RELATION WAS MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS ASSERTED. The C reducer was built with a non-gating --measure formatter and diffed against the independently measured kernel relation over the whole 24-vector corpus and the film fixtures before one conformance assertion existed; NO EXPECTED TABLE APPEARS IN THE EMITTER OR IN THE COMPARATOR, because a conformance theorem whose expected values were transcribed from the other implementation is a TRANSCRIPTION THEOREM. ic32 CANNOT SUBSTITUTE A DUP BY NAME and that cost is representational, not semantic: heap[D] is the cell's value before the rule fires and the other side's substitution afterwards, so a dup is fired from a DEMANDED SIDE and the demanded projection is replaced where it stands, found by a walk over reachable slots that REFUSES (film-projection-not-unique) rather than choosing if it is not unique. The rules fired are ic32's own fire() and app_sup(), unedited. THE TWO TRANSITION SYSTEMS STAY SEPARATE (film_planes): the TRVM calculus film is pre-state -> (rule + locus) -> post-state over the ic32 interaction-net relation, and the derivation evidence relation is DeriveRequest -> evaluate -> DeriveResult; what is shared is HOST INFRASTRUCTURE, not semantics. Film provenance uses the same discipline as derivation.implementation-provenance@4 -- shared ObservedExecutionHost, immutable catalog entry, hash-then-launch, observation keyed over the whole emission -- and REPLAY AND PROVENANCE ARE REPORTED SEPARATELY, because a film can be semantically perfect and its claimed provenance false.
